alerts.title: Acute Kidney Injury
alerts.message: Guidelines state TDF can cause chronic kidney disease and acute kidney injury. Patient has acute kidney injury with creatinine 2.4 mg/dL, up from 0.9 mg/dL. Dehydration from gastroenteritis may also contribute to kidney injury. TDF may be a contributing factor, but non-drug causes like dehydration should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor renal function, consider alternative to TDF
